J: open the Compendium.
P: open the Passive Skill Tree.
O: open the World Tree.
G: cycle disabled toggleable enchantments on the held tool.
W/S while riding: move forward or backward.
A/D while riding: steer every supported mount with gradual, speed-sensitive turning while the camera looks freely.
Sprint + Forward: [[mob/minecraft:horse|Horse]] Gallop, [[mob/minecraft:donkey|Donkey]]/[[mob/minecraft:mule|Mule]] Pack Trot, [[mob/minecraft:camel|Camel]] Canter, or [[mob/minecraft:strider|Strider]] Lava Rush.
Jump on a [[mob/minecraft:horse|Horse]]: immediately perform its full jump without a charge-timing bar. Jump on a [[mob/minecraft:camel|Camel]] to dash; it spends Endurance once per dash. The old vanilla mount jump bar is hidden while mounted, and the player XP bar remains available.
Inventory key while riding: open the mount's inventory, including the shared cargo screen for [[mob/minecraft:llama|Llamas]], [[mob/minecraft:camel|Camels]], [[mob/minecraft:pig|Pigs]], and [[mob/minecraft:strider|Striders]].
Sneak + empty-hand Use on a [[mob/minecraft:llama|Llama]], [[mob/minecraft:camel|Camel]], [[mob/minecraft:pig|Pig]], or [[mob/minecraft:strider|Strider]]: open its shared cargo screen on foot. Other horse-family mounts open their normal inventory when used while sneaking.
Mouse wheel: zoom a tree, scroll guide pages, horse panels, llama cargo, and inventory stats.
Left-drag: pan around a tree.
All key assignments can be changed in Minecraft Controls. If another mod uses the same key, rebind one of them.

The inventory stats panel shows calculated player totals. Scroll it when the list is longer than the panel.
Entity overhead bars can show health, [[stat/cranks-dungeons:energy_shield|Energy Shield]], ailments, armour, and evasion according to client settings.
Damage numbers are colour-coded by physical, fire, cold, lightning, void, drowning, and healing.
The party HUD tracks connected party members.
Mounted HUD bars show the animal's Health and resource: [[mob/minecraft:horse|Horse]] Stamina, [[mob/minecraft:donkey|Donkey]]/[[mob/minecraft:mule|Mule]]/[[mob/minecraft:camel|Camel]] Endurance, or [[mob/minecraft:strider|Strider]] Heat. Both mounted bars can be repositioned in the Mod Menu HUD layout editor.
Mod Menu exposes HUD visibility, scale, placement, entity-bar behaviour, and related client presentation options. These settings do not change server-side combat values.
